emails.subject: Next steps - AI Engineer role
emails.body: Hi, thanks for applying. We enjoyed your profile and would like to invite you to a 45-minute technical interview next week. Please share a few time slots that work for you.

emails.subject: Your application
emails.body: Thank you for your interest in the position. After careful consideration we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely matches our needs. We wish you well in your search.

emails.subject: Application received
emails.body: We confirm receipt of your application. Our talent team reviews every submission and will be in touch if your profile is shortlisted. No further action is required.

emails.subject: Quick chat?
emails.body: Hello! I came across your profile and think you could be a strong fit for a contract role we're hiring for. Are you free for a quick call on Thursday to discuss?

emails.subject: Update on your application
emails.body: Unfortunately the role has been filled internally. We will keep your CV on file for future opportunities.

emails.subject: Thanks - we've got it
emails.body: This is an automated message to let you know your application was submitted successfully. You can track its status in the candidate portal.
